## RE - APP - Daily Operations Report
Collects the read-only sources, converts them to the app report format (contract v1.0) and stores the report in the Rotolo app (Supabase). No email, WhatsApp, DoorLoop writes or tenant contact.

**Before the first run**
1. Import "RE - APP - DoorLoop Snapshot - Read Only", save it, and paste its workflow ID into "DoorLoop Snapshot (APP copy of 03)".
2. Create credential "Rotolo App - Ingest Secret" (Header Auth): name `x-ingest-secret`, value = the secret from the Supabase setup SQL.
3. Run manually. Keep the schedule disabled until a manual run has been reviewed in the app.

A failing source becomes "unavailable" in the report; it never stops the other sources. The FUB-only report (05) also runs each time (read only); its deals are used only if 04 fails, for example on Gmail authorisation.
